spec.section: ## Trigger `/v1/capabilities` or transport probe fails, or a send returns `paused:unreachable`.

## Do
1. Read the effective gateway record, transport mode, open SendManifests and reservations. Do not switch transport silently. 2. Mark affected sends `paused:unreachable` with a monotone manifest revision and audit row. Suspend deadline arithmetic and ladder burn. 3. Hold every reservation charged by a dispatched or unknown attempt. An unreachable gateway is not proof of stop. 4. Probe the configured transport with bounded backoff. Then probe `/v1/capabilities`; require auth, session continuity and canonical idempotency behavior. 5. After a healthy readback, mark the gateway reachable, resume queued work oldest-first, and re-arm deadlines from recorded non-paused time. Do not burst-fire missed reminders. 6. For each in-flight attempt, run `GET /v1/runs/{id}` → `resolve-unknown` → session history. Release a slot only after `proven-stopped` or a matching terminal report.

## Evidence Record gateway id, transport probe output, manifest revisions before/after, held reservation ids, run status, recovery audit id and the first healthy readback. Expected test: `WF-07-GATEWAY-DISCONNECT`.

## Never Do not issue a fresh POST because the socket timed out, do not release on lease expiry, and do not fall back to another transport without an explicit configuration change and readiness cycle.
